block_node.block_desc:
Animate UAV flight paths using translations and rotations.
Translation port accepts a Nx3 matrix. Each row corresponds to xyz-position relative to the inertial frame for each UAV.
Rotation port accepts a matrix of Euler ZYX angle specified as a Nx3 matrix, or a matrix of quaternion parts specified as a Nx4 matrix. Each row corresponds to rotations relative to the inertial frame for each UAV.
When "Enable dynamic UAV mesh configuration" is checked, "UAV Type" port accepts a N element integer vector which contains 1 for multirotor, and 2 for fixed-wing. "UAV Mesh Configuration" port accepts a N row matrix. Each row contains mesh size, color and alpha values for each UAV.
When "Draw marker" is checked, "Marker" port accepts matrix with M rows. Each row corresponds to marker position, size, color, type and filled status of each marker.
Set the inertial frame z-axis direction to "Up" to use ENU frame, and "Down" to use NED frame as inertial frame.

Convert to a specified coordinate transformation representation.

The input and output coordinate transformations may be specified as the representations listed below, where all vectors must be column vectors:

  • Axis-Angle (AxAng): [x y z theta]
  • Euler Angles (Eul): [z y x], [z y z], or [x y z]
  • Homogeneous Transformation (TForm): [4x4] matrix
  • Quaternion (Quat): [w x y z]
  • Rotation Matrix (RotM): [3x3] matrix
  • Translation Vector (TrVec): [x y z]

Set the desired Representation parameter for both the Input and Output coordinate transformations.
